description:
Beautifully updated 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath PUD located in the highly sought after Las Virgenes Village community. This inviting home features tastefully remodeled bathrooms, an open concept floor plan filled with natural light, and a spacious kitchen designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining.

More than just a home, this property offers an incredible Southern California lifestyle. Located within a highly rated school district and just minutes from Malibu’s iconic beaches, scenic hiking and biking trails, boutique fitness studios, charming coffee shops, and some of the area’s best dining. Enjoy convenient access to local favorites like Erewhon, all while being surrounded by the natural beauty and relaxed luxury the area is known for.

Offering the perfect balance of comfort, style, and location, this is a rare opportunity to experience the very best of Calabasas living.
